package.name: ee_leader_marker
package.description:
EE Leader Marker -- a standalone RViz 6-DoF interactive marker that publishes the drag pose as a plain geometry_msgs/PoseStamped. Robot agnostic, single .cpp file, no Pinocchio / OSQP / robotis_interfaces / custom message dependencies. Drop into any ROS 2 Humble+ workspace and parameterize base_frame / controlled_link / colors per arm.
Derived from cyclo_motion_controller_ros eef_interactive_marker_node (Apache-2.0) -- the MoveL output was replaced by PoseStamped so the node has no custom-message coupling.
